Bakerloo.reason: Bakerloo Line: Severe delays between Harrow & Wealdstone and Stonebridge Park due to an earlier signal failure at South Kenton. MINOR DELAYS on the rest of the line due to train cancellations. Tickets will be accepted on London Buses, London Overground and London Northwestern Railway.

Metropolitan.reason: Metropolitan Line: Minor delays due to an earlier fire alert at Northwood.

Piccadilly.reason: PICCADILLY LINE: Saturday 20 June, from 0045, and all day Sunday 21 June, no service between Cockfosters and Uxbridge, including Friday and Saturday Night Tube. Trains continue to run between Acton Town and Heathrow (all terminals). Use METROPOLITAN LINE services between Rayners Lane and Uxbridge.

Victoria.reason:
Victoria Line: We apologise for the ongoing disruption on the Victoria line. Although we successfully resolved the track defect at Walthamstow, another defect was discovered in the Brixton area which we are working hard to fix. As a result, Victoria line Night Tube services will be suspended tonight.
 
Customers are advised to complete journeys on the Victoria line by midnight.

Waterloo & City.reason: Waterloo and City Line: Service will resume at 06:00 on Monday.
